title: Un'asta verticale
code:
import numpy as np
th = np.radians(90)
c, s = np.cos(th), np.sin(th)
k = np.array([[c*c, c*s], [c*s, s*s]])
print(k.round(6))
codeHtml: import numpy as np th = np.radians(90) c, s = np.cos(th), np.sin(th) k = np.array([[c*c, c*s], [c*s, s*s]]) print(k.round(6))
explain: Un'asta verticale ha rigidezza solo lungo y: c = cos 90° = 0 e s = 1, quindi resta il solo termine s².
